Get list of deep traces
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/devices/:deviceid/deeptraces

Get list of deep traces

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
deviceid
integer
REQUIRED

The device ID.

Responses
​
200

List of deep trace with their status

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
trace_id
integer
trace_details
object
status
string

Possible values: [not_started, in_progress, error, done]

created_at
integer

Deep trace created time in epoch seconds

started_at
integer

Deep trace start time in epoch seconds

ended_at
integer

Deep trace end time in epoch seconds

]
